meta.name: ai-rag-pipeline
meta.description: Build RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pipelines with web search and LLMs. Tools: Tavily Search, Exa Search, Exa Answer, Claude, GPT-4, Gemini via OpenRouter. Capabilities: research, fact-checking, grounded responses, knowledge retrieval. Use for: AI agents, research assistants, fact-checkers, knowledge bases. Triggers: rag, retrieval augmented generation, grounded ai, search and answer, research agent, fact checking, knowledge retrieval, ai research, search + llm, web grounded, perplexity alternative, ai with sources, citation, research pipeline

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建带联网搜索的RAG问答管道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为AI应用添加联网检索与引用能力
copy.tagline_en: Build RAG pipelines with web search and LLMs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add web-grounded retrieval and citations to your AI app

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以调用 Tavily、Exa 等搜索工具和多个大语言模型，构建检索增强生成（RAG）流程，用于研究、事实核查和生成带引用的回答。
howto.when: 当用户提出需要联网搜索或事实核查的问题，例如要求“搜索并总结最新AI进展”或“验证某个说法”时触发。

say.text: 搜索2024年量子计算的最新突破并总结。
say.note: Claude 会执行搜索并用 LLM 生成带引用的回答。

say.text: 验证这个说法：AI将在2030年取代50%的工作。
say.note: Claude 会搜索证据并给出事实核查结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Tavily, Exa search tools and multiple LLMs to build RAG pipelines for research, fact-checking, and generating grounded responses with citations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for web search or fact-checking, e.g., 'search and summarize latest AI developments' or 'verify a claim'.

say_en.text: Search for the latest breakthroughs in quantum computing 2024 and summarize.
say_en.note: Claude will search and generate a cited summary.

say_en.text: Fact-check this claim: AI will replace 50% of jobs by 2030.
say_en.note: Claude will search for evidence and provide a verdict.
